results.title: What scientific term or concept ought to be more widely ...
results.content: Often, a system can be changed to accept energy more efficiently, by adding an element called an “impedance matcher.” Most people have never heard of an impedance matcher, but once you know about them, you begin to see them everywhere: in the shape of a trumpet, the anti-reflective coating on a lens, and the foam spikes on the inside of a recording booth. Although born in physiology, it is likely that the idea of allostasis in the coming years can become important as an umbrella for trends currently fermenting in the understanding of the mind. Affordances are “what the environment offers the animal for good or ill,” according to Gibson, and “the information is in the light.” (Gibson, like most psychologists and philosophers of perception, concentrated on vision.)  While many researchers and theoreticians in the fledgling interdisciplinary field of cognitive science found Gibson’s basic idea of affordances compelling, Gibson and his more radical followers managed to create a cult-like aura around his ideas, repelling many otherwise interested thinkers.

results.content: - Familiarize with marker-less biomarkers in the Sensory-Motor Systems Lab - Investigate what regions of the human body are essential for capturing markers of painting actions (e.g., markers in the dominant hand that paints, torso) - Conduct a data collection study with participants to collect their biomarkers - Model the data collected using machine learning and statistical inference in collaboration with Scai Lab - Develop “authenticity labels” composed of unique data correspondences of each participant - Document findings and prepare a final project report - - Hands-on experience in real-time signal processing and machine learning with real human data - Collaboration with an interdisciplinary lab at the intersection of engineering data modeling - Impact on the scientific fields of Robotics, Learning, and Signal Processing - Possibility to have co-authorship of the study results published in a scientific venue - If successful, Labels of Authenticity can be used alongside GenAI models for data ownership recognition with the potential to develop a business case thereafter
